vpc.interface.up.evidence: API 4840 documents adminStatus UP/DOWN; captured object has UP. Wait for administrative enablement only, not attachment completion; DOWN remains pending.

vpc.interface.ready.evidence: API 5803 documents ready / unready / error / unknown in the status field example and captures ready for one portID. ready succeeds, error fails, unready and unknown remain pending.

vpc.mirror.session.on.evidence: API 9048 documents session status on/off and captures on. off remains pending; this waits for enablement, not billing acceptance.

vpc.prefix-list.available.evidence: API 15590 documents associationState 0 available, 1 updating, 2 update failed. Captured prefixList rows have exact prefixListID and state 0; require scalar prefixListID before polling.

vpc.layer2-gateway.active.evidence: API 13214 documents ACTIVE running and FREEZE frozen. Exact l2gwID selects one result; frozen fails a running wait.

vpc.ipv6-gateway.active.evidence: API 5762 documents ACTIVE as the sole normal status and captures it. No terminal failure is documented; unknown and null remain bounded pending.

vpc.peering.accepted.evidence: API 5736 retrieves a single peering instanceID and documents agree accepted, pending awaiting agreement, and rejecting rejected. agree succeeds, rejecting fails, and pending remains pending.

vpc.path.report.usable.evidence: API 16189 documents nodeStatus 0 unusable and 1 usable. This waits for the reported node usability only; 0 remains pending and does not imply asynchronous analysis completion.
